# Synthetic Yapı Kredi World statements

Generated by `tools/synth_yapikredi.py` (fixed seed, byte-identical on every run). Nothing here comes
from a real statement: merchants, amounts, the holder `ORNEK KISI`, the address, the customer, bill and
invoice numbers and the cards `5400 61** **** 4321` (plastic) and `5400 61** **** 8765` (digital) are
invented. Only the line structure of `page.get_text()` follows the real layout.

Each `yk-NN-<cut-off>.pdf` has a `yk-NN-<cut-off>.json` with the ground truth: statement fields, the
printed summary, every transaction (installment plans named by `plan_key`), the expected
reconciliation checks and buckets, and the plans still running after that statement.

| File | Scenarios |
|------|-----------|
| yk-01 | zero balance: the table holds only the opening balance and has no `TOPLAM` row |
| yk-02 | installment A (6x) starts |
| yk-03 | regular month, points cell |
| yk-04 | digital card table, foreign currency sub-line (USD) |
| yk-05 | partial payment |
| yk-06 | annual card fee, interest, points cell, table over a page break |
| yk-07 | last installment of A; B and D (3x each) start: same shop, same day, different totals |
| yk-08 | three-page table, digital card table, card-not-present TRY sub-line |
| yk-09 | refund, last installments of B and D, table over a page break |
| yk-10 | installment C (4x) starts, foreign currency sub-line (EUR), points cell |
| yk-11 | regular month |
| yk-12 | plan C continues beyond the last statement |

The embedded font is a subset of Noto Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1) from `pymupdf-fonts`.
Regenerate with `python tools/synth_yapikredi.py`.
